version: 2.3.0

PC5 2.3.0 is out: a game set to start Unreal's small starter (Ride.exe here) now starts the game's own program (Ride-Win64-Shipping.exe) in its place, so the Visual C++ installer isn't asked for any more. PC5 already has Visual C++ 2015-2022. Please update, start the game and attach the new zip either way.

If the game works then, please close this issue: that adds it to the game compatibility list.
